title: CaptureBundle
description: The output of a single Playwright capture run: screenshots, page model, and environment fingerprint.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Semver-like schema version. Always '1.0' for this revision.

capturedAt.title: Captured at
capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the bundle was written. Excluded from golden comparisons.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.description: The browser viewport configuration used for this capture.

name.title: Viewport name
name.description: Logical name for this viewport, e.g. 'desktop' or 'mobile'.

dsf.title: Device scale factor
dsf.description: Device pixel ratio. 1 means CSS px == PNG px.

environment.title: Environment fingerprint
environment.description: Records the rendering environment so cross-machine comparison can be flagged.

os.title: Operating system
os.description: Value of process.platform at capture time (e.g. 'linux', 'darwin', 'win32').

playwright.title: Playwright version
playwright.description: The exact Playwright package version used.

dsf.title: Device scale factor
dsf.description: Device pixel ratio recorded in the environment fingerprint.

determinism.title: Determinism record
determinism.description: Records the status of every stabilization step so analyze can lower confidence for failed/skipped steps.

animationsDisabled.title: Animations disabled
animationsDisabled.description: Status of the animation/transition kill CSS injection step.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Status of the emulateMedia reducedMotion step.

timeFrozen.title: Time frozen
timeFrozen.description: Status of the clock.install freezeTime step.

randomStubbed.title: Random stubbed
randomStubbed.description: Status of the Math.random LCG seed injection step.

fontsReady.title: Fonts ready
fontsReady.description: Status of the document.fonts.ready wait step.

imagesDecoded.title: Images decoded
imagesDecoded.description: Status of the visible img decode() pass step.

lazyLoadPass.title: Lazy load pass
lazyLoadPass.description: Status of the scroll-to-bottom lazy load pass step.

settled.title: Settled
settled.description: Status of the clock.runFor(settleMs) settle step.

clicked.title: Clicked selectors
clicked.description: List of clickBeforeCapture selectors that were successfully clicked.

hidden.title: Hidden selectors
hidden.description: List of hideSelectors that were applied.

masked.title: Masked selectors
masked.description: List of maskSelectors that were applied.

retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.title: Retried without time freeze
retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.description: True if networkidle timed out with freezeTime on and the page was retried without it.

page.title: Page model
page.description: Extracted page content, metadata, network log, and console output.

redirectChain.title: Redirect chain
redirectChain.description: List of intermediate redirect URLs, with sensitive params redacted.

statusCode.title: HTTP status code
statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the main document response.

title.title: Page title
title.description: The document title, length-capped and control-char-stripped.

metaDescription.title: Meta description
metaDescription.description: Content of <meta name=description>, or empty string if absent.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.description: Content of <link rel=canonical href=...>, or null if absent.

lang.title: Document language
lang.description: Value of <html lang>, or empty string if absent.

nodes.title: Semantic node stream
nodes.description: Ordered list of visible, meaningful elements extracted in document order.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.description: List of ARIA landmark roles present on the page.

network.title: Network log
network.description: Recorded network requests with sensitive data redacted.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: List of network requests made during page load.

url.title: Request URL
url.description: The request URL with sensitive query params redacted.

status.title: HTTP status
status.description: HTTP response status code, or 0 if failed/no response.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: True if the request failed at the network level.

console.title: Console messages
console.description: Browser console messages captured during page load.

level.title: Log level
level.description: Console message level: log, info, warn, error, debug.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.description: Accessibility audit results. Violations array is empty in M1.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Array of axe-core violations. Empty in M1.

computedStyles.title: Computed styles
computedStyles.description: Map of node id to computed style properties. Empty object in M1; populated in M4.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Paths to captured screenshots, relative to the bundle file's parent directory (the outDir).

fullPage.title: Full page screenshot
fullPage.description: Path to the full-page PNG, relative to outDir. E.g. 'desktop/old.png'.

viewport.title: Viewport screenshot
viewport.description: Path to the viewport-only PNG, relative to outDir. E.g. 'desktop/old-vp.png'.

SemanticNode.title: SemanticNode
SemanticNode.description: A visible, meaningful element extracted from the page in document order.

role.title: ARIA role
role.description: The effective ARIA role of this element, or null.

text.title: Visible text
text.description: Normalized innerText of this element, length-capped.

accName.title: Accessible name
accName.description: Accessible name: aria-label || alt || normalized innerText.

href.title: Href
href.description: Absolute resolved href for links, or null.

imageAlt.title: Image alt text
imageAlt.description: Alt attribute value for images, or null.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Bounding box in page coordinates [x, y, width, height] with scroll offsets added. x/y floored, w/h ceiled.

anchors.title: Anchor set
anchors.description: The agent-facing locator fingerprint for this node.

text.title: Text anchor
text.description: Normalized visible text, strongest grep target when present.

href.title: Href anchor
href.description: Absolute resolved href, grep target for links.

alt.title: Alt anchor
alt.description: Image alt text, grep target for images.

nearestHeading.title: Nearest heading
nearestHeading.description: Text of the most recent heading node in document order before this node.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: ARIA landmark role of the nearest landmark ancestor: banner|navigation|main|contentinfo|complementary|form.

ordinalInLandmark.title: Ordinal in landmark
ordinalInLandmark.description: 1-based count of nodes with the same (kind, anchors.text) in the same landmark including self. Null if no landmark.

cssSelector.title: CSS selector
cssSelector.description: Landmark-relative CSS selector for internal re-find use only. Not the agent-facing identifier.
